subject: Request: temporary invoice-only allowlist for Microlytics (no-PO pilot)
messages:
From: Katie Miller <katie.miller@microlytics.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — billing system constraint, can we do invoice-only for short pilot?

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the fast onboarding call last week. One quick operational ask from our side: our accounting system is configured for monthly invoicing and we don't create POs for small pilots under $5k/month. To get started immediately, could Redwood accept invoices (net 30) for the first 60 days while we finalize internal PO setup?

We can provide a signed vendor onboarding form and W-9 upfront, and we are happy to provide payment tracking and an assigned billing contact. If helpful, we can also sign a short acknowledgement limiting spend and agreeing to Redwood's terms for the pilot.

If a temporary invoice-only lane is acceptable, please let me know any evidence or approvals you need and who on your side should be looped in. We hope to go live next Monday.

Best,
Katie Miller
Finance Lead, Microlytics
attachments: W9_KatieMiller.pdf, Microlytics_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Katie Miller <katie.miller@microlytics.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 09:46:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Quick ask — billing system constraint, can we do invoice-only for short pilot?

Priya/Laura —

Microlytics (new trial customer) asked for a 60-day invoice-only path while they stand up a PO. They're providing W-9 and the onboarding form (attached by Katie). Key constraints: pilot spend expected <$5k/mo and they want to start next Monday.

Can procurement/finance evaluate a time-limited exemption (60 days) with the following guardrails:
- Max spend cap: $10,000 total for the pilot period
- Billing contact and invoice cadence: monthly, net 30
- Evidence: W-9 + completed onboarding form + signed acknowledgement of terms
- Auto-escalate to normal PO requirement after 60 days unless a PO is provided

If acceptable, could procurement issue a temporary exemption ID and any templated wording we should send the vendor (DocuSign link etc)? Katie, copying you for transparency — we may need the signed acknowledgement and primary billing contact details today to meet their go-live.

Thanks,
Rishi
Senior Solutions Rep, Redwood Inference

Thanks Rishi — reviewed. Laura/Marissa from procurement/finance, my recommendation: approve a controlled, temporary invoice-only allowlist entry with these conditions: 
- Duration: 60 days starting on first invoice date
- Spend cap: $10,000 cumulative
- Required vendor evidence before first invoice: completed vendor onboarding form, W-9, and a signed "Temporary Invoice-only Acknowledgement" (we have a 1-page template)
- Finance will assign a tracking code and set auto-reminder at day 45 to either close out or convert to PO process
- If vendor misses any billing evidence, exemption is revoked immediately

Marissa, can finance provision the tracking code and confirm we can accept net 30 invoices for this vendor under the exemption? If yes, I'll generate an exemption ID and provide the DocuSign link for the acknowledgement.

Katie — please send the signed onboarding form and W-9 to procurement@redwoodinference.com right away. We will also need the billing contact name and phone.
